criteria.title: Clarifies the customer's problem
criteria.description: The subject asks a relevant question to distinguish the reported problem and confirms what needs to be resolved.

labels.description: The quoted behavior does not clarify the problem.
Asks a relevant clarifying question without confirming the problem.
Asks a relevant question and confirms the customer's problem.

criteria.title: Gives a concrete next step
criteria.description: The subject gives a practical next step and tells the customer what outcome to expect, without promising facts not established in the conversation.

labels.description: The quoted behavior gives no practical next step.
A next step is given but the expected outcome is unclear.
A concrete next step and expected outcome are stated.

criteria.title: Customer confirms the proposed resolution
criteria.description: The conversation contains an explicit customer confirmation that the stated next step resolves or addresses the reported problem. This is a conversation outcome and must not be attributed solely to the subject.

labels.description: The quoted customer response is ambiguous or does not confirm resolution.
The customer explicitly confirms the resolution or proposed next step.

criteria.title: Visual attention
criteria.description: Whether the subject maintains visual attention requires video or an authorized observer and cannot be evaluated from this transcript.

labels.description: The authorized visual observation shows missing visual attention.
The authorized visual observation shows sustained visual attention.
